description: Trading journal — record of every trade taken. Updated after each trade.

reporting_format.instructions: After each trade tell Claude: Asset, Date, Direction, Entry filled (yes/no), Exit price, Result (WIN/STOPPED OUT/NEVER TRIGGERED), R value, Notes
reporting_format.r_explained: 1R = your planned risk on that trade. +2R = won double. -1R = lost planned amount. 0R = never triggered.
